name: Makomo
summary: Makomo was a former student of Sakonji Urokodaki who was slain by the Hand Demon during Final Selection. After her death, she remained as a spirit alongside Sabito and appeared to Tanjiro Kamado to help train him for the Final Selection. She was a skilled swordswoman and Water Breathing user who specialized in correcting Tanjiro's forms and teaching him how to properly utilize Total Concentration Breathing.

stats.attackPotency: Small Building level, higher with Constant Flux
stats.strikingStrength: Small Building level, higher with Constant Flux
stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

notes: Makomo is currently a spirit and therefore lacks a physical body. Her Nichirin Sword is made from sunlight-absorbing Scarlet Crimson Ore and can interact with non-physical targets. Her Water Breathing includes the first ten forms, with Constant Flux gradually increasing the strength of her strikes through momentum. She was skilled enough to train Tanjiro in Water Breathing and Total Concentration Breathing. The VS Battles Wiki profile rates her at most Small Building level, higher with Constant Flux, with Supersonic+ speed.
